statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ has retraced from the session high and has not established a persistent no-retracement path, while post-data cash trading and quarterly expiration keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains WATCH; Tail is below the block threshold, with escalation conditional on observed repeated extension, extreme-holding or failed retracements during the active cash-session window.
headline: WATCH as NQ retraces into post-data expiration trade
body: The latest delayed NQ quote available at 13:53 UTC was 29,842, up 0.33% but well below the 29,966.75 session high and only 38 points above the 29,804 low. The Federal Reserve reported August industrial production unchanged and manufacturing output down 0.3%; BLS reported the national unemployment rate unchanged at 4.1%. The visible retracement supports extreme Stress without an established mean-reversion-failure path.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 hourly assessments, Tail ranged from 17 to 26. Thursday briefly reached orange during a trend-up phase, then normalized overnight and returned to WATCH ahead of Friday's event cluster; the latest published 13:00 UTC assessment was Tail 23 with extreme Stress.
outlookSummary: Near-term risk is concentrated in post-release cash-session digestion and the expiration-driven closing flow. Tail should remain below a block if meaningful retracements persist; repeated extension or extreme-holding would be the key escalation evidence. Active path risk drops sharply after futures close for the weekend, leaving mainly gap/headline risk.
